visualAssets: Original Godot-native geometry, authored for Shadowfell; no external textures.
places: Willows lean over clear water. Tobin keeps his tackle beside the landing.
A quiet pool west of the inn. A good place to fish away an afternoon.
Mayor Alder keeps the village rolls. Some names in the northern burial book have been scratched out.
Young boars root through broken orchard fencing. Beyond the meadow the woods grow darker.
Every headstone faces the old watch. Three family names have been chiselled away.
Three shuttered homes shelter beneath the black trees. Morrow still tends the apothecary.
The procession ends at a sealed family crypt. Its keeper carries the missing names.
No birds drink here. Patient anglers sometimes see a second moon beneath the water.
The old stone points to a hedge north of the timber trail. Osric's new fence is three paces over the line. A faded village seal confirms Heda's claim.
Pig bristles cling to the briars. A lone wolf has been using this run to reach Holt Farm.
